author: reek
body: Equation and system solver. Solves linear equations, quadratic equations, and simple polynomial equations symbolically. Also provides Newton's method for numerical roots. Systems of linear equations are solved via Gaussian elimination.

author: reek
body: A bare power contributes coefficient one; a product contributes the integer on its left. Both end at the same place, so poly-of-pow takes the coefficient rather than being written twice.
